overrides.value: Lets you select an area of a PDF for use in Obsidian, as a companion to the Obsidian-Broken-PDF plugin; it is at an early stage and works only in tabs opened after Zotero starts.
overrides.reason: Condensed from the opening lines and "Known issue" section of README.md. The manifest description, "Zotero Break PDF", only repeats the name, and the GitHub About text is missing.
